name: Hansen GFC v1.12 (global_forest_change_2024_v1_12)
forest_relevance: Direct forest cover and annual loss baseline; weak supervision only for monthly tasks.
notes: Primary v1 baseline. treecover2000 + lossyear + datamask bands. Annual labels; not suitable as monthly ground truth (see ADR 0004). v3 potential as weak supervision signal.

name: Sentinel-2 MSI L2A
forest_relevance: High-resolution optical signal for forest state and disturbance confirmation.
notes: Core v2 input. 10 m optical. Cloud masking required. Monthly compositing with SCL or s2cloudless. v3: usable as input to weakly supervised model.

name: Sentinel-1 GRD (C-band SAR)
forest_relevance: Cloud-robust SAR signal for forest structure and monthly disturbance confirmation.
notes: Cloud-robust v2 complement to Sentinel-2. VV+VH polarizations. Requires speckle filtering and terrain correction. Backscatter sensitive to moisture and structure.

name: Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 L2
forest_relevance: Medium-resolution optical signal and longer archive for baseline and change context.
notes: Longer archive than Sentinel-2. 30 m resolution. Useful where Sentinel-2 pre-dates 2017. v2 potential in mosaic with Sentinel-2.

name: MODIS MOD13Q1 (NDVI/EVI 250m)
forest_relevance: Coarse vegetation phenology context; not suitable for fine forest area by itself.
notes: Coarse resolution. Useful for temporal context or weakly supervised pre-training signals. Not suitable for fine-scale forest mask in v1.

name: GEDI Level 2A/2B (forest height and structure)
forest_relevance: Canopy-height and structure reference for validation or auxiliary learning.
notes: Forest height and canopy structure. Sparse footprint - not suitable for area estimation alone. v3: validation layer or auxiliary feature. Geographically limited by ISS orbit.

name: JRC Tropical Moist Forest (TMF)
forest_relevance: Independent forest/non-forest and degradation reference for humid tropics.
notes: Annual forest / non-forest classification for the humid tropics. Independent of Hansen GFC - useful for cross-validation. Includes deforestation / degradation classes.

name: PRODES (Brazil deforestation)
forest_relevance: Authoritative regional deforestation reference for Brazilian Amazon AOIs.
notes: Authoritative Brazilian deforestation record. High quality for the Legal Amazon. Limited geographic scope. Annual labels. Useful for cross-validation against GFC in Brazilian AOIs.

name: Placeholder - biodiversity context product
forest_relevance: Potential habitat, species, or ecosystem integrity context; must not be treated as forest-cover ground truth.
notes: Replace with a reviewed source such as a biodiversity intactness, protected area, or habitat product.

name: Placeholder - flood and surface-water context product
forest_relevance: Flood or inundation context can explain optical/SAR anomalies and support masking or uncertainty notes.
notes: Replace with a reviewed flood extent, surface water seasonality, or wetland inundation product.

name: Placeholder - renewable energy context product
forest_relevance: Solar, wind, or energy infrastructure context may explain land-use pressure but is not a forest input.
notes: Replace with a reviewed solar resource, wind resource, transmission, or infrastructure product if relevant to AOI interpretation.

name: Placeholder - environmental integrity index
forest_relevance: Integrity indices can support landscape context and uncertainty interpretation; verify components before use.
notes: Replace with a reviewed environmental integrity, ecosystem integrity, or human footprint product.

name: Placeholder - ocean or coastal context product
forest_relevance: Useful for coastal forest, mangrove, estuary, or shoreline AOIs; otherwise out of scope.
notes: Replace with a reviewed ocean color, shoreline, coastal change, or mangrove-context product when relevant.
